notes: Windows works. Until now the host could not start on Windows at all: the binary carried a malformed application manifest, and every Windows build this project has shipped died at launch on it. That is fixed, and the rest of the Windows path with it — the installer asks for what it needs up front instead of failing at its last step, the host starts by itself at the next logon with no console window and a tray icon in place, and Windows Firewall is a button in Desk rather than a command to copy into a console. A phone still holding a host it can no longer reach can be told to forget it and pair again.
